result.summary: Overall the page looks polished, but there are a few visual/layout issues around horizontally scrollable content and the fixed bottom navigation overlapping content.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the restaurant card content at the bottom of the screen. The lower pizza card is partially hidden behind the nav area, which can make content feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the height of the bottom navigation plus safe-area inset, so cards can scroll fully above the nav.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrollable sections are visibly clipped at the right edge, including the category chips and the restaurant cards in the “Fastest near you” row. The partial chip/card can look accidental rather than intentional.
issues.suggestion: If this is meant to indicate horizontal scrolling, ensure the clipping is intentional and balanced. Consider adding a fade, consistent right padding, or snapping so partial items look cleaner.

issues.description: The third restaurant title in the “Fastest near you” row is cut off at the screen edge, making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Keep text within the visible card bounds or apply a clear ellipsis/truncation style only when the card itself is mostly visible.
